tasks.title: Transactional migration repair with savepoints
tasks.prompt: You are fixing a broken migration script after partial deployment. Produce PostgreSQL 16 SQL only. Requirements: use BEGIN/COMMIT, per-table SAVEPOINT, rollback to savepoint on error, log failures into migration_audit(table_name, step, error_text, failed_at), continue processing next table. Tables: customers, orders, order_items, payments.

tasks.title: Oracle MERGE rewrite to ON CONFLICT
tasks.prompt: Rewrite an Oracle MERGE for table invoice_summary into PostgreSQL 16 SQL only. Must use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(invoice_id) DO UPDATE, preserve changed_at update only when amount differs, and include WHERE clause in DO UPDATE to avoid no-op writes.

tasks.title: Range partition conversion with default partition
tasks.prompt: Convert Oracle monthly range partitioned SALES table into PostgreSQL 16 declarative partitioning. Output SQL only. Include parent table, at least 3 monthly partitions for 2026-01..2026-03, default partition, matching indexes, and check constraints preserved.

tasks.title: JSONB migration with schema guards
tasks.prompt: Write PostgreSQL 16 SQL only that migrates text column payload_raw to JSONB payload in events. Requirements: add payload JSONB if missing, safely cast valid JSON only, route invalid rows to events_quarantine with reason, add GIN index on payload, and keep operation idempotent.

tasks.title: Window-based reconciliation query
tasks.prompt: Create a PostgreSQL 16 reconciliation SQL only. For table ledger(tx_id, account_id, amount, posted_at), detect suspicious sequences: 3+ debits within 10 minutes exceeding 5000 total per account, and output account_id, first_tx, last_tx, total_amount, txn_count.

tasks.title: Trigger chain conversion with deterministic order
tasks.prompt: Generate PostgreSQL 16 SQL only for BEFORE INSERT and BEFORE UPDATE trigger logic on inventory that sets updated_at, updated_by, and enforces qty >= 0. Use separate trigger function(s), deterministic behavior, and explicit SECURITY DEFINER decision.

tasks.title: Performance rewrite for anti-pattern query
tasks.prompt: Rewrite an Oracle-style correlated subquery report into performant PostgreSQL 16 SQL only. Must avoid per-row scalar subqueries, use CTEs or joins, support pagination and stable ordering, and include indexes recommendations as SQL comments.

tasks.title: Online backfill with chunking
tasks.prompt: Write PostgreSQL 16 SQL only for online backfill from orders_legacy to orders_new in chunks of 5000 rows by id range. Must be restart-safe, avoid duplicates, and track checkpoints in backfill_state(table_name, last_id, updated_at).
